text: File WM-7100. The claim arises from a rear-end collision on a signalised arterial. The claimant was struck from behind while stopped at a signal. The claimant, aged 31, sustained cervical strain with no imaging abnormality; treatment concluded at four months with no residual restriction. Liability is contested. The defendant's account of the incident conflicts with the claimant's on the central facts and no independent witness has been located. The claimant did not seek treatment for eleven weeks after the incident and attended fewer than half of the sessions subsequently prescribed. The file contains no wage records and no itemised billing; the economic loss figure in the demand is unsupported by any document in the file.
